newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker but still in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker but still in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled weaker and near the day's lows but the May contract managed to hold support at 10.68 cents and maintain its recent trading range.
The market set its range early as the speculators continued to liquidate positions. Trade buying was brisk at the lows, which supported the spot month at 10.71 cents.
While prices could remain rangebound in the near term, the market is expected to gradually work lower as world supplies are seen outpacing demand.
Technically, July closed below its 50-day moving average of 10.56 cents, at 10.53 cents. May ended just above its 60-day moving average of 10.74 cents.
The spot month closed down 0.13 cent at 10.75 cents per lb, having ranged from 10.88 cents to 10.71 cents. The back months closed 0.08 and 0.07 cent weaker.
Volume was estimated at 19,083 lots compared to Tuesday's official 7,713 lots.
